claims_and_limits: Release October 21, 2026; LTS support at least October 2027.
Direct Parquet querying, glob and filename are established capabilities; filename virtual column default since 1.3.0.
Correct submitted SQL typographic quotes and missing wildcard to exports/*.parquet; add ORDER BY for deterministic presentation. Nonrecursive. Empty files have no result group.
No independent DuckDB runtime execution or benchmark in this article; example syntax checked against versioned documentation.
Async I/O covers Parquet, CSV and native reads per final release; July design article predates native-format completion. No generic performance multiplier claimed.
Evaluation workflow and hypothetical report are editorial assessment, not reported case study.
Migration guide distinguishes new v2-format files (unreadable by older versions) from existing files retaining format. Test queries/extensions and recovery.

visual.central_question: What infrastructure does this file analysis actually need?
visual.argument: Preserve inputs, validate the answer, measure workload, then decide deployment.
